facts.fact: The education minister said about 200 teachers in 40 schools were under inspection for not entering pupils' marks in SIGE during a union-backed grade freeze, entry within the legal period being an obligation on teachers; the date is the article's, 1 June 2024, and no level or total of schools is given.
